svg.text: TV / MAKEUP CABINET v9 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Assemble left, centre and right top cases separately while on the floor.
2. Fit the centre top-box divider BEFORE fitting its two doors; do not omit it.
3. Left top box contains the accessible LED driver and distribution/dimmer space.
4. Route DC wiring through modelled passages before lifting and anchoring the boxes.
